I’ve visited your restaurant a couple of times before, but this is now the second time I’ve experienced extremely poor service and terrible food quality.I had ordered one guava and litchi flavored mocktail, garlic bread, chicken biryani, and chicken crispy. As always, I clearly told the server my preference for the order sequence — garlic bread, chicken crispy, and the mocktail to be served first. But instead, the waiter brought only the chicken crispy and then the biryani. The biryani was left lying at the counter for almost 10 minutes for no reason before being served.
Being from the hospitality industry myself, I was quite disappointed to see such carelessness.Then the mocktail arrived — completely mishandled. It came overloaded with chili powder, and no one bothered to inform or explain this beforehand. I have never tasted such an unpleasant mocktail in my life.Finally, while eating the biryani, I found a hair in the dish. I calmly informed the waiter, but he didn’t react at all — no apology, no concern, nothing. He just changed the plate and walked off as if nothing had happened. Completely unprofessional.
I’m writing this because people spend their hard-earned money to dine at your restaurant, and receiving such pathetic service and quality is unacceptable.
After this experience, I will never visit your restaurant again, nor will I recommend it to anyone I know.
Maybe one guest leaving won’t affect you much, but I truly hope you reflect on this and improve your service and standards.
